Headline: No trains between Harlem/Lake and Ashland/Lake
ShortDescription: Green Line service has been temporarily suspended between Harlem/Lake and Ashland/Lake due to an unauthorized person on the tracks.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
Green Line service has been temporarily suspended between Harlem/Lake and Ashland/Lake due to an unauthorized person on the tracks.

As a result, trains are operating only between 63rd stations and Ashland/Lake at this time.

Shuttle buses have been requested from Harlem/Lake to Ashland/Lake in both directions to provided service through the affected area. 

Consider other service alternatives that may serve your trip, such as nearby bus routes, or using buses to other rail lines.

Theses may include:

#90 Harlem
Pace #305

See station personnel for further assistance and pay attention to announcements on trains and at stations for service information.

We are working to restore service as quickly as possible. Allow extra travel time.
